propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded, conflating 'author forgot to declare' with 'ticket genuinely touches no repo file'.
An undeclared ticket falls back to whole-HEAD freshness so any repo commit invalidates its plan-review attestation and forces re-review.
A single non-closed child with empty file_impact poisons its container's inherited drift scope back to whole-HEAD invalidation.
Introduce tri-state file_impact_scope of undeclared, paths, or none, with a required no_file_impact_reason when none.
A declared-none ticket keeps its attestation valid across unrelated commits and is neutral in container roll-up, and P9 passes.
A new no-file-impact plan-review criterion fires only when the assertion is present and uses LLM judgment to verify its truthfulness, with scope changes altering the material fingerprint.
